retained_limits: Unique supported occurrences only; repeated/ambiguous sources, stale/wrong basis, locks, unsupported physical/cross-sheet component ownership and explicit bound-Port unbinding remain guarded.
No new interactive Drag/stretch, implicit reconnect or tolerance policy. Label interior slide keeps incident wires fixed and physical partitions equal; strict Symbol-pin interior refusal remains.
NoConnect relocation remains delete/recreate at an actual pin. Port Move preserves position-only Set semantics and existing explicit membership.
Full schematic/physical/HUMAN, performance and broader release qualification are not claimed; historical ERC results may be stale and no ERC-clean claim is made.
Owner preliminary lag/picking observations and selected pin/text legibility or Navigator clipping remain intake dat-schematic-editing-usability-gvwr; they are not fabricated source/cache fixes.
excluded_failures: Earlier wrong shortcut/pane and reviewer input/watchdog failures are retained in ordinary_gui_review; they do not establish product PASS or invalidate unrelated completed evidence.
